page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column. Running head with page number at the top right. Signature "A 2" and catchword "minor:" at the foot.

main_text.p: tum convertitur, Amafo oram radente: mox ad Dullarti initium, in terras fe insinuantis, veluti linguam aut cuneum efformans, cujus in extremitate Reida vicus quondam percelebris, nunc castellum modò militare eft, inter meridiem & occafum aliquoufque, deinde quafi incitantibus fe in terram fluctibus, ulteriùs etiam in Occidentem longo spatio litus retrahit, iterum brevi flexu in ortum redit, atque eodem pene, quo in occidentem ierat, spatio, in quo Midwoldicum fanum quatuor turribus conspicuum fese offert, rurfus procurrit: postremò aliis etiam minoribus finibus receptis ad terminum auftrinum contendit, ubi cœnobium eft Hilligerlæum, Hispanicâ clade nuper nobilitatum, & Bellingwoldii. Ab eo termino per palustria & arenosa ad Oftergoæ limitem longo tractu recurrit, Westerwoldios primùm, dein Drentiam ad meridiem habens: idque latus meridionale omnium ejus laterum est maximum, xxvi millibus passuum non brevius. Ager totus dimidio fere, quàm Translavicanus, minor:

page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout and is transcribed as plain s (e.g. "fe" as "se", "fpatio" as "spatio", "finibus" as "sinibus", "Oftergoæ" as "Ostergoæ"). The running head ends in a mark that may be a colon or stop; marked [?]. The word "fanum" is kept as printed; the f reads as a real f. Page number and signature read as printed. Faint marks at the right edge are the digitiser's watermark and were left out.
